numbers.font: JetBrains Mono, Roboto Mono, or standard monospace
numbers.style: Highly mechanical, monospaced for exact odometer alignment. Font size fluid text-5xl to text-7xl.

layouts.reactor_core: relative w-[85vmin] max-w-[700px] aspect-square rounded-full flex items-center justify-center bg-[#111] shadow-[inset_0_0_80px_rgba(0,0,0,1),0_0_50px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)] border-[12px] border-[#222]

components.name: RecordReactor
components.instructions: Main container. Must be exactly 100vh. Render the central physical machine environment. Control the state for the selected record index (0 to 11).

components.name: MechanicalDial
components.instructions: Outer rotating ring of the reactor with 12 segments/nodes. Use framer-motion. Users can click a node or drag the ring to rotate. Snap to 30-degree increments. Update the parent selected index state.

components.name: OdometerDrum
components.instructions: Takes the numerical value of the active record. Split into digits. For each digit, render a column of numbers (0-9) inside an `overflow-hidden` container. Animate the column's `y` translation using Framer Motion to roll to the correct digit. Use top/bottom gradients inside the container to simulate the curve of a physical drum.

components.name: GaugeArcs
components.instructions: SVG arcs overlaying the reactor. They should animate (fill up or rotate) with a sharp 'enamel red' color when a new record is selected, simulating physical pressure or RPM.

motion.odometer_spin: Use Framer Motion spring: { type: 'spring', stiffness: 60, damping: 15, mass: 1 }. Stagger the animation of each digit slightly.
motion.dial_rotation: Spring animation for rotating the dial: { type: 'spring', stiffness: 50, damping: 20 }.
motion.reduced_motion: Wrap animations in a check for `useReducedMotion`. If true, bypass the spin/roll and instantly set the values.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Heavy use of inset shadows on the odometer and dial to simulate physical depth and metallic bevels.
visual_enhancers.textures: Carbon fiber background for the room. Radial gradients on the dial to simulate brushed metal.
visual_enhancers.glow: text-shadow on the timing strip to mimic fluorescent LED displays. e.g. text-shadow: 0 0 8px #CCFF00.

accessibility.keyboard: Dial MUST be focusable. Allow Left/Right or Up/Down arrows to select previous/next record. Add `tabIndex={0}` to the reactor container.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-live='polite' in an off-screen span that announces the active record title and value. The visual odometer should be aria-hidden.
accessibility.test_ids: Apply unique data-testid to EVERY interactive and critical data element: 'records-container', 'reactor-dial', 'odometer-drum-[index]', 'timing-strip-label', 'dial-node-[index]'.

carbon_fiber.description: Hexagonal carbon fiber texture for the fixed environment background.

instructions_to_main_agent: COMPLETELY REBUILD RecordsMonument.jsx into 'The Record Reactor'. Provide .js files only.
ABSOLUTELY NO editorial layouts, no changing color worlds, no slide transitions, and no floating cards. Maintain a single, fixed industrial environment (dark, metallic, enamel red, fluorescent).

DO NOT implement an internal scroll trap. The native page wheel MUST continue to bubble up so it moves between Gallery ↔ Records ↔ Milestones seamlessly. The reactor interaction must rely solely on pointer clicks, drag, and keyboard.

Odometer Implementation: Treat each digit as a separate column of numbers (0-9). Use `overflow-hidden` on the wrapper and `framer-motion` to animate the `y` translation of the column to simulate a rolling physical drum. Use monospace fonts for exact alignment.
The 12 records must be selectable via a circular mechanical dial (turbine ring) around the odometer. Each of the 12 records has a node on the dial. Clicking a node or dragging the dial rotates it.
Use the 2026 record values EXACTLY as supplied by the user (e.g., 106 wins, 207 podiums, etc). Map out 12 primary records using this data.
Preserve the single-screen architecture (`h-screen`) and ensure responsive design from 1920x800 down to 320x700 by using `vmin` units for the central reactor core.
Maintain spatial route coordinates: ensure the layout reserves space and safe zones for 'Back to Circuit' and 'CH.05' navigation.
Theme Context safety: Ensure that if the global app theme is toggled, it does not reset the currently selected record index in the React state. The state must persist.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container using .App { text-align: center; }
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Never use placeholder URLs. Use provided image URLs.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it.
